add_to_global_suppression.label: Add to Global Unsubscribe List
add_to_global_suppression.description: Add one or more email addresses to the global suppression list, stopping all future emails to them

emails.label: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to add to the global suppression list, as a JSON list.

add_to_global_suppression.beforeRequest:
request.body = {recipient_emails: JSON.parse(inputs.emails).map((email) => String(email).trim()).filter((email) => email.length > 0)};
return request;

remove_from_global_suppression.label: Remove from Global Unsubscribe List
remove_from_global_suppression.description: Remove an email address from the global suppression list, allowing it to receive emails again

email.label: Email
email.description: Email address to remove from the global suppression list

check_global_suppression.label: Check Global Unsubscribe Status
check_global_suppression.description: Check whether an email address is on the global suppression list
